title: Zesty Smoky Norwegian Lamb Roast
description: A roasted Norwegian lamb dish featuring sazon and smoky flavors, perfect for a special occasion, and is sugar-free-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together sazon seasoning, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Rub the spice mixture all over the lamb roast, making sure to coat it evenly.
Heat the olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the lamb roast on all sides until browned, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and roast the lamb for 20 minutes per pound, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
Baste the lamb with pan juices every 20 minutes to keep it moist.
Remove the lamb from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
Garnish with fresh rosemary sprigs and serve hot.
